cases.narrative:
He told investigators he found a tool that he made from rope and walked up behind Bishop as she sat in a kitchen chair. He said he strangled her “as hard as he could” until she “slumped to the ground.” Police say he strangled her then dumped her body in her pickup truck at a Walmart on US 1 in Sebastian. According to the arrest report, Despres said he carried Bishop's body to the master bedroom, put her in bed, face up, and slept beside her. Early the next morning, Despres said he changed Bishop's clothes, put her body in her Chevy Silverado, and drove to Walmart. After leaving her there, he told police he rode his bike home. Police found her body in the passenger seat of her pickup truck. She had ligature marks and a deep cut on her neck.
